examples.en: A tornado warning was issued for the whole area last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚整個地區發布了龍捲風警報。

examples.en: In science class, we learned how a tornado forms.
examples.zh: 在自然課上，我們學到了龍捲風是如何形成的。

examples.en: The family stayed in the basement until the tornado passed.
examples.zh: 全家人待在地下室，直到龍捲風過去。

examples.en: The company registered its new logo as a trademark.
examples.zh: 公司把新標誌註冊為商標。

examples.en: Using another company's trademark without permission can cause legal trouble.
examples.zh: 未經許可使用別家公司的商標，可能會惹上法律麻煩。

examples.en: A friendly smile became the trademark of the young chef.
examples.zh: 親切的笑容成了這位年輕主廚的招牌特色。

examples.en: Doctors will transplant a new kidney into the patient next week.
examples.zh: 醫師下週將為這位病患移植一顆新的腎臟。

examples.en: We should transplant the small tomato plants into larger pots.
examples.zh: 我們應該把這些小番茄苗移植到較大的盆子裡。

examples.en: Farmers transplant rice seedlings into the field in early spring.
examples.zh: 農夫在初春時把秧苗移植到田裡。

examples.en: The patient is waiting for a heart transplant.
examples.zh: 這位病患正在等待心臟移植。

examples.en: The hospital performs hundreds of kidney transplants each year.
examples.zh: 這間醫院每年進行數百例腎臟移植手術。

examples.en: After the transplant, he had to take medicine every day.
examples.zh: 移植手術後，他每天都得吃藥。

examples.en: Stars twinkle in the clear sky above the mountain village.
examples.zh: 星星在山村上方晴朗的夜空中閃爍。

examples.en: The Christmas lights twinkled on the tree in the living room.
examples.zh: 客廳聖誕樹上的燈飾閃爍著。

examples.en: Her eyes twinkled when she opened the birthday gift.
examples.zh: 她打開生日禮物時，眼睛閃閃發亮。

examples.en: There was a twinkle in the old man's eye as he told the joke.
examples.zh: 老先生講笑話時，眼裡閃著光。

examples.en: A tiny twinkle of light appeared far out at sea.
examples.zh: 遠方的海上出現了一點小小的閃光。

examples.en: The twinkle of the city lights made the bridge look beautiful at night.
examples.zh: 城市燈火的閃爍讓這座橋在夜裡顯得很美。

examples.en: The balloon floated slowly upward into the clear blue sky.
examples.zh: 氣球慢慢往上飄進晴朗的藍天。

examples.en: She looked upward and saw a plane crossing the sky.
examples.zh: 她抬頭向上看，看見一架飛機劃過天空。

examples.en: The path leads upward to a small temple on the hill.
examples.zh: 這條小路向上通往山丘上的一間小廟。

examples.en: An upward trend in sales made the manager very happy.
examples.zh: 銷售額上升的趨勢讓經理非常高興。

examples.en: The teacher drew an upward arrow to show the rise in temperature.
examples.zh: 老師畫了一個向上的箭頭來表示氣溫上升。

examples.en: She felt an upward pull as the elevator started moving.
examples.zh: 電梯開始移動時，她感到一股向上的拉力。

examples.en: Water vapor rises from the hot soup in the bowl.
examples.zh: 熱湯的水蒸氣從碗裡升起。

examples.en: Clouds form when water vapor in the air turns into tiny drops.
examples.zh: 空氣中的水氣變成小水滴時，就會形成雲。

examples.en: Water vapor condensed on the bathroom mirror after the hot shower.
examples.zh: 洗完熱水澡後，水蒸氣在浴室鏡面上凝結成水珠。

examples.en: The children played with great vigor in the school yard.
examples.zh: 孩子們在校園裡精力充沛地玩耍。

examples.en: Regular exercise helps older people keep their health and vigor.
examples.zh: 規律的運動能幫助長者保持健康與活力。

examples.en: The new manager started the project with fresh vigor.
examples.zh: 新經理以嶄新的活力展開了這項專案。

senses.zh: 精力充沛的；強而有力的；劇烈的

examples.en: Doctors suggest vigorous exercise at least three times a week.
examples.zh: 醫師建議每週至少從事三次劇烈運動。

examples.en: The grandfather is still vigorous at the age of eighty.
examples.zh: 爺爺八十歲了仍然精力充沛。

examples.en: She gave the bottle a vigorous shake before opening it.
examples.zh: 她在打開瓶子前用力搖了搖。

examples.en: The violinist played a beautiful song at the school concert.
examples.zh: 小提琴手在學校音樂會上演奏了一首優美的曲子。

examples.en: Her sister dreams of becoming a famous violinist.
examples.zh: 她的姊姊夢想成為知名的小提琴家。

examples.en: The orchestra welcomed a young violinist from Vienna.
examples.zh: 樂團歡迎一位來自維也納的年輕小提琴手。

senses.zh: 原始的；初榨的；未被踩踏的

examples.en: Tourists came to see the virgin forest on the island.
examples.zh: 遊客前來參觀島上的原始森林。

examples.en: The salad was made with extra virgin olive oil.
examples.zh: 這份沙拉是用特級初榨橄欖油做的。

examples.en: The hikers were the first to walk on the virgin snow.
examples.zh: 登山客是第一批走在未被踩踏的雪地上的人。

examples.en: The letters a, e, i, o, and u are vowels.
examples.zh: 字母 a、e、i、o、u 是母音字母。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to circle every vowel in the word.
examples.zh: 老師要我們圈出單字中的每個母音。

examples.en: In the word sky, the letter y represents a vowel sound.
examples.zh: 在 sky 這個字中，字母 y 代表母音。

examples.en: The nurse walked through the children's ward every hour.
examples.zh: 護理師每小時巡視一次兒童病房。

examples.en: My grandmother stayed in the surgery ward for a week.
examples.zh: 我奶奶在外科病房住了一週。

examples.en: Each ward in the city elects one member to the council.
examples.zh: 市內每個行政區各選出一名議員進入議會。

examples.en: I bought a waterproof jacket for the rainy hiking trip.
examples.zh: 我為這趟下雨的健行之旅買了一件防水外套。

examples.en: This watch is waterproof up to fifty meters.
examples.zh: 這支手錶可防水到五十公尺。

examples.en: The tent is made of waterproof cloth to keep us dry.
examples.zh: 這頂帳篷以防水布料製成，能讓我們保持乾燥。

examples.en: My grandfather has deep wrinkles around his eyes when he smiles.
examples.zh: 爺爺笑的時候，眼角有很深的皺紋。

examples.en: Iron the shirt to remove every wrinkle before the interview.
examples.zh: 面試前先把襯衫燙平，去掉所有的皺褶。

examples.en: The wrinkles on the map made it hard to read.
examples.zh: 地圖上的皺褶讓它很難閱讀。

examples.en: Cotton shirts wrinkle easily if you do not hang them up.
examples.zh: 如果不把棉質襯衫掛起來，它們很容易起皺。

examples.en: She wrinkled her nose at the strong smell of the fish.
examples.zh: 她聞到魚的強烈氣味，皺起了鼻子。

examples.en: Please do not wrinkle your uniform before the ceremony.
examples.zh: 請不要在典禮前把制服弄皺。

examples.en: I usually eat yogurt with fresh fruit for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐通常會吃優格配新鮮水果。

examples.en: This kind of yogurt has less sugar than the others.
examples.zh: 這種優格的糖比其他的少。

examples.en: She added a spoonful of honey to her yogurt.
examples.zh: 她在優格裡加了一匙蜂蜜。

examples.en: People often abbreviate Doctor as Dr. in written English.
examples.zh: 在英文書寫中，人們常把 Doctor 縮寫成 Dr.。

examples.en: You can abbreviate the long title to fit on the card.
examples.zh: 你可以把冗長的標題縮短，好讓它放得進這張卡片。

examples.en: We abbreviated the names of the months in the table.
examples.zh: 我們在表格裡把月份的名稱縮寫了。

examples.en: All visitors must abide by the rules of the museum.
examples.zh: 所有參觀者都必須遵守博物館的規定。

examples.en: I cannot abide the loud noise from the construction site.
examples.zh: 我無法忍受工地傳來的吵雜噪音。

examples.en: Our teacher said we should abide by our promise to the class.
examples.zh: 老師說我們應該信守對全班的承諾。

examples.en: The museum has a special exhibit on aboriginal art.
examples.zh: 博物館有一個關於原住民藝術的特展。

examples.en: Researchers are working to save aboriginal languages.
examples.zh: 研究人員正努力保存原住民語言。

examples.en: Aboriginal peoples have lived on this island for thousands of years.
examples.zh: 原住民族已在這座島上生活了數千年。

examples.en: Fish abound in the rivers near the village.
examples.zh: 村子附近的河流裡魚類很多。

examples.en: Stories about the old temple abound in this town.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮上有關那間古廟的故事比比皆是。

examples.en: The market abounds with fresh fruit in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天的市場裡充滿了新鮮水果。

senses.zh: 抽象概念；抽象作品；抽象化

examples.en: Freedom is an abstraction that is hard to explain to young children.
examples.zh: 自由是個很難向小孩解釋的抽象概念。

examples.en: The painting is an abstraction of shapes and bright colors.
examples.zh: 這幅畫是由形狀與鮮豔色彩構成的抽象作品。

examples.en: In math class, we move from real objects to abstraction.
examples.zh: 在數學課上，我們從實際物體進展到抽象化。

examples.en: The island has an abundance of fresh fruit in summer.
examples.zh: 這座島在夏天有大量的新鮮水果。

examples.en: Rain brought an abundance of water to the dry farmland.
examples.zh: 雨水為乾旱的農地帶來了大量的水。

examples.en: They lived in abundance and never worried about money.
examples.zh: 他們過著富裕的生活，從不為錢擔心。

examples.en: She wore a red scarf as a fashion accessory.
examples.zh: 她戴了一條紅圍巾當作時尚飾品。

examples.en: This store sells phone cases and other accessories.
examples.zh: 這家店販售手機殼和其他配件。

examples.en: He bought a few accessories for his bicycle, such as a bell and a light.
examples.zh: 他為自己的腳踏車買了幾樣配件，像是鈴鐺和車燈。

examples.en: The young singer won wide acclaim for her first album.
examples.zh: 這位年輕歌手憑首張專輯贏得廣泛的讚譽。

examples.en: The movie received great acclaim from critics around the world.
examples.zh: 這部電影受到世界各地影評人的高度讚揚。

examples.en: His work as a teacher earned him public acclaim.
examples.zh: 他的教學工作為他贏得了大眾的讚揚。

examples.en: The building was made in accordance with safety rules.
examples.zh: 這棟建築是依照安全規定建造的。

examples.en: Everything went in accordance with our plan.
examples.zh: 一切都按照我們的計畫進行。

examples.en: In accordance with school policy, students must wear uniforms.
examples.zh: 依照學校規定，學生必須穿制服。

examples.en: Please read the notice and act accordingly.
examples.zh: 請閱讀公告，並依此行事。

examples.en: Prices went up, and customers adjusted their spending accordingly.
examples.zh: 價格上漲，顧客也相應地調整了花費。

examples.en: The test was difficult. Accordingly, the teacher gave everyone extra time.
examples.zh: 考試很難，因此老師多給了大家一些時間。

examples.en: Managers are accountable for the work of their teams.
examples.zh: 經理要為團隊的工作負責。

examples.en: Everyone should be accountable for their own choices.
examples.zh: 每個人都應該為自己的選擇負責。

examples.en: The mayor promised to be accountable to the citizens.
examples.zh: 市長承諾要對市民負責。

examples.en: Snow began to accumulate on the roof overnight.
examples.zh: 雪一夜之間開始在屋頂上累積。

examples.en: She hopes to accumulate enough money for a trip to Japan.
examples.zh: 她希望存夠錢去日本旅行。

examples.en: Over the years, he accumulated a large collection of stamps.
examples.zh: 多年來，他累積了大量的郵票收藏。

examples.en: The accumulation of snow on the roads caused traffic delays.
examples.zh: 道路上的積雪造成了交通延誤。

examples.en: Regular saving leads to the accumulation of wealth over time.
examples.zh: 定期儲蓄會讓財富隨著時間累積。

examples.en: The accumulation of knowledge takes years of patient study.
examples.zh: 知識的累積需要多年耐心的學習。

examples.en: The student denied the accusation of copying his friend's work.
examples.zh: 這名學生否認抄襲朋友作業的指控。

examples.en: Making a false accusation against someone can hurt them badly.
examples.zh: 對別人提出不實的指控，可能會嚴重傷害對方。

examples.en: The company rejected the accusation that it had hidden the problem.
examples.zh: 公司駁回了隱瞞問題的指控。

examples.en: It took a while to accustom myself to the cold weather.
examples.zh: 我花了一段時間才讓自己習慣這種寒冷的天氣。

examples.en: Parents should accustom their children to going to bed early.
examples.zh: 父母應該讓孩子習慣早點上床睡覺。

examples.en: She worked hard to accustom her ears to fast English speech.
examples.zh: 她努力讓自己的耳朵習慣快速的英語。

examples.en: Many teenagers worry about acne on their faces.
examples.zh: 許多青少年都為臉上的痘痘感到煩惱。

examples.en: The doctor gave her some cream for her acne.
examples.zh: 醫師給了她一些治療青春痘的藥膏。

examples.en: Washing your face twice a day may help prevent acne.
examples.zh: 一天洗兩次臉可能有助於預防青春痘。

examples.en: The plant's adaptation to dry weather helps it survive.
examples.zh: 這種植物對乾燥氣候的適應能力，讓它得以存活。

examples.en: Moving to a new school requires quick adaptation from every student.
examples.zh: 轉到新學校需要每位學生迅速適應。

examples.en: The movie is an adaptation of a famous children's book.
examples.zh: 這部電影是由一本著名的童書改編而成的。

examples.en: Phone addiction is becoming a problem for many teenagers.
examples.zh: 手機成癮正成為許多青少年的問題。

examples.en: He is trying to overcome his addiction to sugary drinks.
examples.zh: 他正努力戒掉對含糖飲料的癮。

examples.en: Doctors say game addiction can affect sleep and schoolwork.
examples.zh: 醫師表示，遊戲成癮可能影響睡眠與課業。

examples.en: The school office administers the entrance exam every spring.
examples.zh: 學校辦公室每年春天負責辦理入學考試。

examples.en: Only a trained nurse may administer this medicine to patients.
examples.zh: 只有受過訓練的護理師才能給病患施用這種藥。

examples.en: The city hired a manager to administer the new park.
examples.zh: 市政府聘請了一位經理來管理這座新公園。

examples.en: The admiral inspected the ships at the naval base.
examples.zh: 海軍上將視察了海軍基地裡的軍艦。

examples.en: My grandfather was an admiral in the navy for twenty years.
examples.zh: 我爺爺在海軍擔任了二十年的上將。

examples.en: A statue of a famous admiral stands near the harbor.
examples.zh: 一座著名海軍上將的雕像矗立在港口附近。

examples.en: Adolescence is a time of rapid change in both body and mind.
examples.zh: 青春期是身心都快速變化的時期。

examples.en: Many people make their closest friends during adolescence.
examples.zh: 許多人在青春期結交最親近的朋友。

examples.en: She wrote a book about her difficult adolescence in a small town.
examples.zh: 她寫了一本書，記述自己在小鎮度過的艱難青春期。

examples.en: The government issued a travel advisory for the storm area.
examples.zh: 政府針對暴風雨地區發布了旅遊警示。

examples.en: A health advisory warned people to stay indoors because of poor air quality.
examples.zh: 一則健康警示提醒大眾，因空氣品質不佳而待在室內。

examples.en: The weather advisory said that strong winds were coming.
examples.zh: 氣象警報指出將有強風來襲。

examples.en: She serves on an advisory committee for the school.
examples.zh: 她擔任學校顧問委員會的成員。

examples.en: The group plays an advisory role and does not make final decisions.
examples.zh: 這個團體只扮演顧問的角色，不做最後的決定。

examples.en: An advisory board will review the new plan next month.
examples.zh: 一個顧問委員會下個月將審查這項新計畫。

examples.en: The new park has great aesthetic value for the city.
examples.zh: 這座新公園對這座城市具有很高的美學價值。

examples.en: The designer made small aesthetic changes to improve the look of the room.
examples.zh: 設計師做了些小小的美感調整，讓房間看起來更好看。

examples.en: Her aesthetic taste shows in the way she arranges flowers.
examples.zh: 她的審美品味表現在她插花的方式上。

examples.en: My grandmother is a warm and affectionate person.
examples.zh: 我奶奶是個溫暖又充滿愛意的人。

examples.en: The puppy is gentle and affectionate with children.
examples.zh: 這隻小狗對孩子既溫馴又親熱。

examples.en: She gave her little brother an affectionate hug before school.
examples.zh: 上學前，她給了弟弟一個充滿愛意的擁抱。

senses.zh: 附屬機構；加盟單位；關係企業

examples.en: The local TV station is an affiliate of a national network.
examples.zh: 這家地方電視台是全國性電視網的加盟台。

examples.en: The bank opened a new affiliate in the north of the city.
examples.zh: 這家銀行在市區北邊開了一家新的關係企業。

examples.en: Our school is an affiliate of the national sports association.
examples.zh: 我們學校是全國體育協會的附屬單位。

examples.en: The small college decided to affiliate with the larger university.
examples.zh: 這所小型學院決定與那所較大的大學建立正式關聯。

examples.en: Our club chose to affiliate with the national association.
examples.zh: 我們的社團選擇加入全國協會成為會員。

examples.en: Several local shops affiliate with the same delivery service.
examples.zh: 幾家當地商店與同一家外送服務合作。

examples.en: The mayor affirmed that the bridge would open on time.
examples.zh: 市長確認這座橋將會準時通車。

examples.en: The test results affirm that the new method works well.
examples.zh: 測試結果證實這個新方法很有效。

examples.en: Teachers should affirm students when they work hard.
examples.zh: 老師應該在學生努力時給予肯定。

examples.en: Store the cookies in an airtight container to keep them fresh.
examples.zh: 把餅乾存放在密封容器裡，以保持新鮮。

examples.en: The team made an airtight plan, and nothing could go wrong.
examples.zh: 團隊擬定了一份無懈可擊的計畫，不會出任何差錯。

examples.en: Make sure the lid is airtight before you put the jar in the bag.
examples.zh: 把罐子放進袋子前，請確認蓋子是密封的。

examples.en: The doctor checked that the patient's airway was clear.
examples.zh: 醫師檢查並確認病患的呼吸道暢通。

examples.en: Smoke can irritate the airway and make breathing difficult.
examples.zh: 煙霧會刺激呼吸道，使呼吸變得困難。

examples.en: Air traffic controllers directed the plane along a designated airway.
examples.zh: 飛航管制員引導飛機沿著指定航路飛行。

examples.en: Algebra uses letters like x and y to stand for numbers.
examples.zh: 代數用 x 和 y 這類字母來代表數字。

examples.en: My brother needs help with his algebra homework tonight.
examples.zh: 我弟弟今晚需要有人協助他完成代數作業。

examples.en: Students usually learn algebra in junior high school.
examples.zh: 學生通常在國中學習代數。

senses.zh: 使疏遠；使反感；使格格不入

examples.en: Harsh words can alienate friends and family.
examples.zh: 刻薄的話會讓朋友和家人疏遠。

examples.en: The new rule alienated many loyal customers.
examples.zh: 這項新規定使許多忠實顧客感到反感。

examples.en: He felt alienated from his classmates after moving to a new city.
examples.zh: 搬到新城市後，他覺得自己和同學格格不入。

examples.en: The report alleges that the factory polluted the river.
examples.zh: 報告指稱這家工廠污染了河川。

examples.en: Some people allege that the old building is haunted.
examples.zh: 有些人聲稱那棟老建築鬧鬼。

examples.en: The customer alleged that the store had charged her twice.
examples.zh: 顧客聲稱店家向她收了兩次錢。

examples.en: An alligator lay still beside the muddy river.
examples.zh: 一隻短吻鱷靜靜地躺在泥濘的河邊。

examples.en: We saw a huge alligator at the zoo on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們週日在動物園看到一隻巨大的短吻鱷。

examples.en: Alligators live in warm swamps in the southern United States.
examples.zh: 短吻鱷生活在美國南部溫暖的沼澤中。

examples.en: The ambiguity of the question confused many students.
examples.zh: 這道題目的含糊不清讓許多學生感到困惑。

examples.en: The contract should be written clearly to avoid ambiguity.
examples.zh: 合約應該寫得清楚，以避免模稜兩可。

examples.en: There is some ambiguity in this sentence, so it has two meanings.
examples.zh: 這個句子有些歧義，因此有兩種意思。

examples.en: The microphone amplifies the singer's voice so everyone can hear.
examples.zh: 麥克風把歌手的聲音放大，讓每個人都聽得到。

examples.en: Social media can amplify small problems into big arguments.
examples.zh: 社群媒體可能把小問題放大成大爭論。

examples.en: Stress can amplify the pain you feel after exercise.
examples.zh: 壓力可能加劇運動後感受到的疼痛。

examples.en: The teacher used an analogy to explain how electricity flows.
examples.zh: 老師用類比來解釋電是如何流動的。

examples.en: There is a clear analogy between a heart and a pump.
examples.zh: 心臟與幫浦之間有明顯的類比關係。

examples.en: Her analogy comparing the brain to a computer helped us understand.
examples.zh: 她把大腦比作電腦的比喻幫助我們理解。

examples.en: She has an analytical mind and enjoys solving math problems.
examples.zh: 她頭腦善於分析，喜歡解數學題。

examples.en: The report takes an analytical approach to the sales data.
examples.zh: 這份報告以分析的方式處理銷售資料。

examples.en: Analytical skills are important for this job.
examples.zh: 分析能力對這份工作很重要。

examples.en: The sailors dropped the anchor near the small harbor.
examples.zh: 水手們在小港口附近拋下了錨。

examples.en: Our teacher is the anchor of the whole class.
examples.zh: 我們的老師是全班的精神支柱。

examples.en: The news anchor read the headlines at six o'clock.
examples.zh: 新聞主播在六點鐘播報頭條新聞。

examples.en: The ship will anchor outside the bay tonight.
examples.zh: 這艘船今晚會在海灣外拋錨。

examples.en: Please anchor the tent firmly to the ground.
examples.zh: 請把帳篷牢牢固定在地面上。

examples.en: They anchor the shelf to the wall with strong screws.
examples.zh: 他們用堅固的螺絲把架子固定在牆上。

examples.en: A warm smile can animate a quiet room.
examples.zh: 溫暖的笑容能讓安靜的房間活絡起來。

examples.en: The studio will animate the story for television.
examples.zh: 這家工作室將把這個故事製作成電視動畫。

examples.en: Good music helped animate the whole party.
examples.zh: 好聽的音樂讓整場派對熱鬧了起來。

examples.en: Plants and animals are animate, but rocks are not.
examples.zh: 植物和動物是有生命的，但石頭不是。

examples.en: Scientists study animate and inanimate objects in different ways.
examples.zh: 科學家用不同的方式研究有生命與無生命的物體。

examples.en: The test asked whether each noun was animate.
examples.zh: 測驗要求判斷每個名詞是否指稱有生命的事物。

examples.en: She sighed in annoyance when the bus was late again.
examples.zh: 公車又誤點了，她惱怒地嘆了口氣。

examples.en: Loud phone calls on the train are a common annoyance.
examples.zh: 在火車上大聲講電話是常見的惱人行為。

examples.en: He could not hide his annoyance at the long wait.
examples.zh: 他掩飾不住對漫長等待的不耐煩。

examples.en: Everyone stood up when the national anthem began.
examples.zh: 國歌響起時，大家都站了起來。

examples.en: The school anthem is sung at every graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 每場畢業典禮都會唱校歌。

examples.en: That song became the anthem of the summer.
examples.zh: 那首歌成了這個夏天的主題曲。

examples.en: The doctor gave me an antibiotic for my throat infection.
examples.zh: 醫師開了抗生素給我治療喉嚨感染。

examples.en: You should finish the whole course of the antibiotic.
examples.zh: 你應該把整個療程的抗生素吃完。

examples.en: This antibiotic is not effective against the flu.
examples.zh: 這種抗生素對流感沒有效。

examples.en: The hospital uses an antibiotic cream on small wounds.
examples.zh: 醫院在小傷口上使用抗生素藥膏。

examples.en: Antibiotic treatment can take several days to work.
examples.zh: 抗生素治療可能需要幾天才會見效。

examples.en: Farmers are limiting the use of antibiotic drugs on animals.
examples.zh: 農民正在限制對動物使用抗生素藥物。

examples.en: The children waited with great anticipation for the school trip.
examples.zh: 孩子們滿心期待地等著校外教學。

examples.en: In anticipation of the storm, we bought extra water.
examples.zh: 預期暴風雨將來襲，我們多買了一些水。

examples.en: There was a feeling of anticipation before the concert began.
examples.zh: 演唱會開始前，現場瀰漫著期待的氣氛。

examples.en: The antonym of hot is cold, as shown in this exercise.
examples.zh: 如這個練習所示，「熱」的反義詞是「冷」。

examples.en: Can you think of an antonym for the word brave?
examples.zh: 你想得出「勇敢」這個字的反義詞嗎？

examples.en: Our English test included a section on synonyms and antonyms.
examples.zh: 我們的英文考試有一個關於同義詞和反義詞的部分。

examples.en: This rule is applicable to all students in the school.
examples.zh: 這項規定適用於學校的所有學生。

examples.en: Please fill in the form if it is applicable to you.
examples.zh: 如果這份表格適用於你，請填寫。

examples.en: The discount is not applicable to sale items.
examples.zh: 這項折扣不適用於特價商品。

examples.en: He worked as an apprentice in a bakery for two years.
examples.zh: 他在一家麵包店當了兩年學徒。

examples.en: The young apprentice learned how to repair watches.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的學徒學會了如何修理手錶。

examples.en: Every apprentice needs patience and a good teacher.
examples.zh: 每位學徒都需要耐心與一位好老師。

examples.en: The approximate cost of the trip is five thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 這趟旅行的大約花費是五千元。

examples.en: Please give me an approximate arrival time.
examples.zh: 請告訴我大約的抵達時間。

examples.en: His answer was only approximate, not exact.
examples.zh: 他的答案只是近似值，並不精確。

examples.en: The shape of the cloud seemed to approximate a heart.
examples.zh: 那朵雲的形狀看起來近似一顆心。

examples.en: Can you approximate the number of people in the room?
examples.zh: 你能大致估計房間裡的人數嗎？

examples.en: The model tries to approximate real weather conditions.
examples.zh: 這個模型試圖呈現接近真實的天氣狀況。

examples.en: She studies archaeology at a university in Tainan.
examples.zh: 她在台南的一所大學讀考古學。

examples.en: Archaeology helps us learn about ancient cultures.
examples.zh: 考古學幫助我們認識古代文化。

examples.en: The museum has a special exhibit on archaeology.
examples.zh: 博物館有一場關於考古學的特展。

examples.en: The library keeps old newspapers in its archive.
examples.zh: 圖書館把舊報紙保存在檔案庫裡。

examples.en: I found the photo in the school archive.
examples.zh: 我在學校的檔案庫裡找到了那張照片。

examples.en: The city archive is open to the public on weekdays.
examples.zh: 市立檔案館平日對外開放。

examples.en: Please archive all the old emails from last year.
examples.zh: 請把去年的舊電子郵件全部存檔。

examples.en: The office will archive these documents next month.
examples.zh: 辦公室下個月會把這些文件存檔。

examples.en: We archive our photos on an external hard drive.
examples.zh: 我們把照片存檔在外接硬碟裡。

examples.en: My little brother has asthma and carries an inhaler.
examples.zh: 我弟弟有氣喘，隨身帶著吸入器。

examples.en: Cold air can make her asthma worse.
examples.zh: 冷空氣會讓她的氣喘更嚴重。

examples.en: Asthma often starts in childhood, but adults can develop it too.
examples.zh: 氣喘常在兒童時期發病，但成人也可能罹患。

examples.en: The little dog wandered astray in the busy market.
examples.zh: 那隻小狗在熱鬧的市場裡走失了。

examples.en: Our plans went astray because of the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 我們的計畫因為大雨而出了差錯。

examples.en: Bad friends led him astray during high school.
examples.zh: 高中時期，壞朋友把他帶入了歧途。

examples.en: The astronomer used a large telescope to look at Mars.
examples.zh: 天文學家用大型望遠鏡觀察火星。

examples.en: An astronomer discovered a new comet last night.
examples.zh: 一位天文學家昨晚發現了一顆新彗星。

examples.en: She wants to become an astronomer when she grows up.
examples.zh: 她長大後想成為天文學家。

examples.en: Our school has an astronomy club that meets on Fridays.
examples.zh: 我們學校有一個星期五聚會的天文社。

examples.en: Astronomy is the study of stars and planets.
examples.zh: 天文學是研究恆星與行星的學問。

examples.en: He bought a book on astronomy for his nephew.
examples.zh: 他買了一本天文學的書給他的姪子。

examples.en: She worked hard to attain her goal of becoming a nurse.
examples.zh: 她努力工作，要達成成為護理師的目標。

examples.en: Few students can attain a perfect score on this exam.
examples.zh: 很少有學生能在這場考試中拿到滿分。

examples.en: It takes years of practice to attain this level of skill.
examples.zh: 要達到這種技術水準需要多年的練習。

examples.en: The flight attendant offered us water and snacks.
examples.zh: 空服員為我們提供了水和點心。

examples.en: A parking attendant showed us where to leave the car.
examples.zh: 停車場服務人員告訴我們把車停在哪裡。

examples.en: The museum attendant answered our questions politely.
examples.zh: 博物館的服務人員有禮貌地回答了我們的問題。

examples.en: The company passes an audit every year.
examples.zh: 這家公司每年都會通過查帳。

examples.en: The auditor found an error during the audit.
examples.zh: 審計人員在查帳時發現了一處錯誤。

examples.en: An audit of the school budget will take two weeks.
examples.zh: 學校預算的審計需要兩週。

examples.en: The firm will audit our accounts in March.
examples.zh: 這家事務所將在三月查核我們的帳目。

examples.en: They audit the records to make sure the numbers are correct.
examples.zh: 他們查核紀錄，確保數字無誤。

examples.en: She plans to audit a history course at the local university.
examples.zh: 她計畫在當地大學旁聽一門歷史課。

examples.en: The graduation ceremony was held in the school auditorium.
examples.zh: 畢業典禮在學校禮堂舉行。

examples.en: The auditorium can seat more than five hundred people.
examples.zh: 這座禮堂可容納五百多人。

examples.en: Students lined up outside the auditorium before the speech.
examples.zh: 演講前，學生們在禮堂外排隊。

examples.en: Quick action helped avert a serious accident.
examples.zh: 迅速的行動幫助避免了一場嚴重的意外。

examples.en: She looked down to avert her eyes from the bright light.
examples.zh: 她低下頭，把視線從強光移開。

examples.en: The two countries worked together to avert a crisis.
examples.zh: 兩國攜手合作，避免了一場危機。

examples.en: He works in the aviation industry as an engineer.
examples.zh: 他在航空業擔任工程師。

examples.en: The museum has a hall about the history of aviation.
examples.zh: 博物館有一個介紹航空史的展廳。

examples.en: Aviation safety rules are very strict to protect passengers and crew.
examples.zh: 航空安全規定非常嚴格，以保障乘客和機組人員的安全。

examples.en: We had an awesome time at the beach.
examples.zh: 我們在海邊玩得很開心。

examples.en: Your new bike looks awesome with its bright blue frame!
examples.zh: 你的新腳踏車配上亮藍色的車架，看起來好棒！

examples.en: The view from the top of the mountain was awesome.
examples.zh: 從山頂看出去的景色令人驚嘆。

examples.en: Let's rest awhile before we continue walking.
examples.zh: 我們先休息一會兒，再繼續走。

examples.en: She stayed awhile to help us clean the classroom.
examples.zh: 她留了一會兒，幫我們打掃教室。

examples.en: Wait awhile and the soup will cool down.
examples.zh: 等一會兒，湯就會涼了。

examples.en: My uncle is a bachelor and lives alone in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是單身漢，獨自住在台北。

examples.en: She earned a bachelor's degree in business last year.
examples.zh: 她去年取得了商學學士學位。

examples.en: He is a bachelor of science from a national university.
examples.zh: 他是國立大學的理學學士。

examples.en: A strong backbone helps the body stay upright.
examples.zh: 強健的脊椎幫助身體保持挺直。

examples.en: Small businesses are the backbone of the local economy.
examples.zh: 小型企業是地方經濟的骨幹。

examples.en: It takes backbone to admit your mistakes in public.
examples.zh: 在眾人面前承認錯誤需要骨氣。

examples.en: Each student wears a name badge on the first day.
examples.zh: 每位學生第一天都會戴上名牌。

examples.en: The scout proudly showed us his new badge.
examples.zh: 那位童軍自豪地向我們展示他的新徽章。

examples.en: Please show your badge to the guard at the gate.
examples.zh: 請向大門的警衛出示你的識別證。

examples.en: The company held a banquet for its employees at a hotel.
examples.zh: 公司在飯店為員工舉辦了一場宴會。

examples.en: We were invited to a wedding banquet last Saturday.
examples.zh: 上週六我們受邀參加婚宴。

examples.en: The chef prepared a huge banquet for the guests.
examples.zh: 主廚為賓客準備了一場豐盛的宴席。

examples.en: The movie is about a barbarian who invades a city.
examples.zh: 這部電影講的是一個入侵城市的野蠻人。

examples.en: Our history textbook explains why ancient Romans called foreign tribes barbarians.
examples.zh: 我們的歷史課本解釋了古羅馬人為何把外族稱為野蠻人。

examples.en: Don't act like a barbarian at the dinner table.
examples.zh: 在餐桌上別表現得像個野蠻人。

examples.en: He plays the bass in a school band.
examples.zh: 他在學校樂團裡彈貝斯。

examples.en: The speakers have a deep bass that shakes the floor.
examples.zh: 這些喇叭的低音很深沉，連地板都在震動。

examples.en: My father caught a large bass at the lake.
examples.zh: 我爸爸在湖裡釣到了一條大鱸魚。

examples.en: Her brother sings in the bass section of the choir.
examples.zh: 她哥哥在合唱團的低音部唱歌。

examples.en: The bass drum set the rhythm of the march.
examples.zh: 大鼓定下了行進的節奏。

examples.en: He has a deep bass voice that suits the choir.
examples.zh: 他有一副低沉的男低音嗓音，很適合合唱團。

examples.en: The batter swung and hit the ball over the fence.
examples.zh: 打擊手一揮棒，把球打過了圍欄。

examples.en: Mix the flour and eggs to make a smooth batter.
examples.zh: 把麵粉和蛋混合，調成滑順的麵糊。

examples.en: The next batter stepped up to the plate.
examples.zh: 下一位打擊手走上了打擊區。

examples.en: Strong waves batter the coast every winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天強浪都會猛烈拍打海岸。

examples.en: The wind began to batter the old wooden door.
examples.zh: 風開始猛烈撞擊那扇老舊的木門。

examples.en: Heavy rain continued to batter the town all night.
examples.zh: 大雨整夜持續襲擊小鎮。

examples.en: Students planted flowers to beautify the school yard.
examples.zh: 學生們種花來美化校園。

examples.en: The city plans to beautify the park before the festival.
examples.zh: 市政府計畫在節慶前美化公園。

examples.en: We bought paint to beautify our living room.
examples.zh: 我們買了油漆來美化客廳。

examples.en: I heard a beep from my phone.
examples.zh: 我聽到手機發出嗶的一聲。

examples.en: Please leave a message after the beep.
examples.zh: 請在嗶聲後留言。

examples.en: The microwave gave a loud beep when the food was ready.
examples.zh: 食物熱好時，微波爐發出響亮的嗶聲。

examples.en: The alarm will beep if the door stays open.
examples.zh: 如果門一直開著，警報器就會嗶嗶響。

examples.en: The taxi driver began to beep at the slow truck.
examples.zh: 計程車司機對著慢吞吞的卡車按起了喇叭。

examples.en: My watch beeps every hour to remind me to stretch.
examples.zh: 我的手錶每小時都會嗶嗶響，提醒我伸展身體。

examples.en: Please call us beforehand if you plan to visit.
examples.zh: 如果你打算來訪，請事先打電話給我們。

examples.en: I studied the map beforehand, so we did not get lost.
examples.zh: 我事先看過地圖，所以我們沒有迷路。

examples.en: They told the guests about the change beforehand.
examples.zh: 他們事先告知了賓客這項變動。

examples.en: The hotel offers a free welcome beverage to every guest.
examples.zh: 這家飯店提供每位客人一杯免費的迎賓飲料。

examples.en: Hot and cold beverages are sold at the school store.
examples.zh: 學校的福利社販售熱飲和冷飲。

examples.en: Which beverage would you like with your meal?
examples.zh: 你的餐點想搭配哪種飲料？

examples.en: The two countries signed a bilateral trade agreement.
examples.zh: 兩國簽署了雙邊貿易協定。

examples.en: The doctor checked for bilateral swelling in both legs.
examples.zh: 醫師檢查雙腿是否都出現腫脹。

examples.en: Bilateral talks will start next week in Tokyo.
examples.zh: 雙邊會談下週將在東京展開。

examples.en: Firefighters worked all night to stop the blaze.
examples.zh: 消防人員整晚努力撲滅大火。

examples.en: The campfire grew into a bright blaze.
examples.zh: 營火燒成了明亮的烈焰。

examples.en: A blaze destroyed the old warehouse before firefighters could reach it.
examples.zh: 消防人員趕到之前，一場大火就燒毀了那間舊倉庫。

examples.en: The fire began to blaze in the fireplace.
examples.zh: 壁爐裡的火開始熊熊燃燒。

examples.en: The sun blazed down on the empty street.
examples.zh: 烈日炙烤著空蕩蕩的街道。

examples.en: Lights blaze from every window of the tall building.
examples.zh: 高樓的每扇窗戶都燈火通明。

examples.en: Be careful not to spill bleach on your clothes.
examples.zh: 小心不要把漂白水灑在衣服上。

examples.en: My mother cleans the bathroom with bleach.
examples.zh: 我媽媽用漂白水清潔浴室。

examples.en: Bleach should be kept away from children.
examples.zh: 漂白水應該放在小孩拿不到的地方。

examples.en: She used lemon juice to bleach the old shirt.
examples.zh: 她用檸檬汁漂白那件舊襯衫。

examples.en: The strong sun can bleach the color from curtains.
examples.zh: 強烈的陽光會使窗簾褪色。

examples.en: He decided to bleach his hair for the school play.
examples.zh: 他決定為學校的戲劇演出替頭髮漂色。

examples.en: There was a large ink blot on my homework.
examples.zh: 我的作業上有一大塊墨漬。

examples.en: The blot on the white shirt would not come out.
examples.zh: 那件白襯衫上的汙漬洗不掉。

examples.en: A single blot spoiled the beautiful painting.
examples.zh: 一個汙點毀了那幅美麗的畫。

examples.en: Use a paper towel to blot the spilled juice.
examples.zh: 用紙巾把灑出來的果汁吸乾。

examples.en: Be careful not to blot your page with the leaking pen.
examples.zh: 小心別讓那支漏墨的筆把你的紙頁弄髒。

examples.en: She tried to blot the water from her notebook.
examples.zh: 她試著把筆記本上的水吸乾。

examples.en: This knife is too blunt to cut the bread.
examples.zh: 這把刀太鈍了，切不了麵包。

examples.en: He gave a blunt answer to the question.
examples.zh: 他對這個問題給出了直率的回答。

examples.en: The teacher was blunt about my poor test results.
examples.zh: 老師直言我的考試成績很差。

examples.en: Using a pencil on rough paper will blunt it quickly.
examples.zh: 在粗糙的紙上用鉛筆會讓筆尖很快變鈍。

examples.en: Years of failure did not blunt her hope.
examples.zh: 多年的失敗並沒有削弱她的希望。

examples.en: Cold weather can blunt your sense of taste.
examples.zh: 寒冷的天氣可能會讓味覺變遲鈍。

examples.zh: 這部電影講述一個女孩遇見自己的複製人。

examples.en: Scientists can clone cells in a laboratory.
examples.zh: 科學家可以在實驗室中複製細胞。

examples.en: You can clone the repository to your own computer.
examples.zh: 你可以把這個儲存庫複製到自己的電腦。

examples.en: The company tried to clone its rival's website.
examples.zh: 這家公司試圖仿造對手的網站。

examples.en: The closure of the bridge caused heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 橋梁封閉造成嚴重塞車。

examples.en: The store announced its closure after twenty years.
examples.zh: 這家商店在營業二十年後宣布歇業。

examples.en: Talking with her friend gave her a sense of closure.
examples.zh: 和朋友談過之後，她感覺事情告一段落了。

examples.en: Several parties formed a coalition to govern the country.
examples.zh: 數個政黨組成聯合政府來治理國家。

examples.en: A coalition of local groups is working to clean up the river.
examples.zh: 當地團體組成的聯盟正致力清理這條河。

examples.en: The coalition of teachers asked for smaller class sizes.
examples.zh: 教師聯盟要求縮小班級人數。

examples.en: The road follows the coastline for fifty kilometers.
examples.zh: 這條公路沿著海岸線延伸五十公里。

examples.en: Taiwan has a long and beautiful coastline.
examples.zh: 台灣有綿長又美麗的海岸線。

examples.en: Rising seas may change the coastline of small islands.
examples.zh: 海平面上升可能改變小島的海岸線。

examples.en: A colloquial style is fine for texting friends but not for essays.
examples.zh: 口語寫法用來傳訊息給朋友沒問題，但不適合寫作文。

examples.en: The author uses colloquial language to sound friendly.
examples.zh: 作者使用口語化的語言，讓文字讀來親切。

examples.en: Colloquial expressions can be hard for learners to understand.
examples.zh: 口語表達對學習者來說可能很難理解。

examples.en: A bright comet will pass near the Earth next month.
examples.zh: 一顆明亮的彗星下個月將從地球附近經過。

examples.en: We stayed up late to watch the comet.
examples.zh: 我們熬夜看彗星。

examples.en: A comet develops a tail of gas and dust as it approaches the Sun.
examples.zh: 彗星接近太陽時，會形成由氣體和塵埃組成的尾巴。

examples.en: Smartphones are now commonplace among teenagers, even in small rural towns.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機如今在青少年之間十分普遍，即使在鄉村小鎮也是如此。

examples.en: Traffic jams are commonplace on holiday weekends.
examples.zh: 假日週末塞車是司空見慣的事。

examples.en: Online shopping has become commonplace in many families.
examples.zh: 網路購物在許多家庭已經很普遍。

examples.en: Many former British colonies belong to the Commonwealth.
examples.zh: 許多前英國殖民地都是大英國協的成員。

examples.en: The leaders of the Commonwealth meet every few years.
examples.zh: 大英國協的領袖每隔幾年會面一次。

examples.en: Poland and Lithuania once formed a commonwealth.
examples.zh: 波蘭與立陶宛曾組成一個聯邦。

examples.en: My neighbor is a communicative old man who greets everyone.
examples.zh: 我的鄰居是個健談的老先生，會跟每個人打招呼。

examples.en: The communicative approach helps students speak English more confidently.
examples.zh: 溝通式教學法幫助學生更有自信地說英語。

examples.en: He is not very communicative in the morning.
examples.zh: 他早上不太愛說話。

examples.en: The hikers used a compass to find their way out of the forest.
examples.zh: 登山客用指南針找出走出森林的路。

examples.en: Use a compass to draw a circle for your geometry homework.
examples.zh: 做幾何作業時，用圓規畫一個圓。

examples.en: A compass always points toward magnetic north.
examples.zh: 指南針總是指向磁北。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to compile a list of our favorite books.
examples.zh: 老師要求我們彙整一份最愛的書單。

examples.en: Reporters compiled facts from several sources for the article.
examples.zh: 記者從幾個來源彙整事實寫成這篇報導。

examples.en: The software will compile the code in a few seconds.
examples.zh: 軟體會在幾秒內編譯這段程式碼。

examples.en: A light salad will complement the pasta well.
examples.zh: 清爽的沙拉與義大利麵很相配。

examples.en: Her calm style complements his energetic one.
examples.zh: 她沉穩的風格與他活力十足的風格相輔相成。

examples.en: The new curtains complement the color of the sofa.
examples.zh: 新窗簾與沙發的顏色很相配。

examples.en: The wine is a perfect complement to the cheese.
examples.zh: 這款酒是起司的絕佳搭配。

examples.en: This course is a useful complement to your regular classes.
examples.zh: 這門課是對你一般課程的有益補充。

examples.en: The team now has its full complement of players.
examples.zh: 球隊現在球員編制齊全。

examples.en: The portrait shows a young woman with a smooth, clear complexion.
examples.zh: 這幅肖像畫中的年輕女子有著光滑、乾淨無瑕的臉部皮膚。

examples.en: Lack of sleep gave him a pale complexion.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足讓他臉色蒼白。

examples.en: The new evidence changed the whole complexion of the case.
examples.zh: 新的證據改變了整個案件的面貌。

examples.en: The school offers a comprehensive reading program.
examples.zh: 這所學校提供全面的閱讀課程。

examples.en: We bought comprehensive insurance for the trip.
examples.zh: 我們為這趟旅行買了全險。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a comprehensive list of study tips.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們一份詳盡的讀書技巧清單。

examples.en: The library plans to computerize its records this year.
examples.zh: 圖書館打算今年把館藏紀錄電腦化。

examples.en: Many banks have computerized their services to reduce long waiting times.
examples.zh: 許多銀行已將服務電腦化，以縮短冗長的等候時間。

examples.en: It took months to computerize the hospital's files.
examples.zh: 醫院的檔案花了好幾個月才完成電腦化。

examples.en: He thanked his comrades for their help.
examples.zh: 他感謝夥伴們的幫忙。

examples.en: The old soldier met his comrade after many years.
examples.zh: 那位老兵事隔多年與他的戰友重逢。

examples.en: The workers called each other comrade at the meeting.
examples.zh: 工人們在會議上彼此稱呼同志。

examples.en: Both sides made a concession to end the dispute.
examples.zh: 雙方各自讓步，以結束爭議。

examples.en: Students can get a concession on train tickets.
examples.zh: 學生購買火車票可享有優惠。

examples.en: The company won a concession to run the cafeteria.
examples.zh: 這家公司取得了經營餐廳的特許權。

examples.en: Please write a concise summary of the article.
examples.zh: 請為這篇文章寫一份簡明的摘要。

examples.en: His answer was concise and easy for the interviewer to understand.
examples.zh: 他的回答很簡潔，面試官很容易理解。

examples.en: The guide gives concise directions to the station.
examples.zh: 這份指南提供了前往車站的簡明路線。

examples.en: Heat the milk gently to condense it before making the dessert.
examples.zh: 製作甜點前，輕輕加熱牛奶，使它濃縮。

examples.en: Can you condense your report into one page?
examples.zh: 你能把報告濃縮成一頁嗎？

examples.en: Water vapor condenses on the cold window.
examples.zh: 水蒸氣在冰冷的窗戶上凝結。

examples.en: The nations formed a confederation to protect trade.
examples.zh: 這些國家組成聯盟來保護貿易。

examples.en: Our teacher explained how a confederation differs from a single country.
examples.zh: 老師解釋了邦聯與單一國家有何不同。

examples.en: The sports confederation will meet in Tokyo next month.
examples.zh: 這個體育聯盟下個月將在東京開會。

examples.en: The congresswoman visited our school last week.
examples.zh: 那位女國會議員上週來我們學校參訪。

examples.en: She is a respected congresswoman in her state.
examples.zh: 她是州內備受敬重的女國會議員。

examples.en: Students wrote letters to the congresswoman about the new park.
examples.zh: 學生們寫信給那位女議員，談論新公園的事。

examples.en: The conquest of the island took several years.
examples.zh: 征服這座島花了好幾年。

examples.en: The book describes the conquest of ancient Egypt.
examples.zh: 這本書描述了古埃及被征服的經過。

examples.en: He boasted about his latest conquest in the chess club.
examples.zh: 他在西洋棋社吹噓自己最新的勝利。

examples.en: She is a conscientious student who never misses homework.
examples.zh: 她是個認真負責的學生，從不漏交作業。

examples.en: Our conscientious driver checked the bus before every trip.
examples.zh: 我們細心的司機每次出發前都會檢查巴士。

examples.en: A conscientious worker always double-checks the numbers.
examples.zh: 認真負責的員工總會再次核對數字。

examples.en: We should conserve water during the dry season.
examples.zh: 乾季期間我們應該節約用水。

examples.en: The group works to conserve the local forest.
examples.zh: 這個團體致力於保護當地森林。

examples.en: Turn off the lights to conserve energy.
examples.zh: 關燈以節約能源。

examples.en: Her kind words were a great consolation to me.
examples.zh: 她親切的話語對我是很大的安慰。

examples.en: The team lost, but won a consolation prize.
examples.zh: 球隊輸了比賽，卻拿到了安慰獎。

examples.en: It was little consolation that the rain stopped later.
examples.zh: 雨後來停了，也沒帶來多少安慰。

examples.en: She tried to console her crying little brother.
examples.zh: 她試著安慰哭泣的弟弟。

examples.en: Friends came to console him after the bad news.
examples.zh: 聽到壞消息後，朋友們前來安慰他。

examples.en: Nothing could console the team after the loss.
examples.zh: 輸球之後，什麼都無法安慰這支球隊。

examples.en: He bought a new game console for his birthday.
examples.zh: 他買了一台新的遊戲主機當生日禮物。

examples.en: The pilot checked the control console before starting the engine.
examples.zh: 飛行員在啟動引擎前檢查了控制台。

examples.en: The console sits next to the television in the living room.
examples.zh: 主機放在客廳電視旁邊。

examples.en: Police uncovered a conspiracy to rob the bank.
examples.zh: 警方揭發了一起搶銀行的陰謀。

examples.en: Some people suspect a conspiracy behind every major news story.
examples.zh: 有些人懷疑每則重大新聞背後都有陰謀。

examples.en: The movie is about a conspiracy inside a large company.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述一家大公司內部的陰謀。

examples.en: There is much contention over the new school rules.
examples.zh: 新校規引發了許多爭論。

examples.en: It is my contention that homework should be shorter.
examples.zh: 我的論點是功課應該要少一點。

examples.en: The two teams are in contention for the title.
examples.zh: 這兩支隊伍正在爭奪冠軍。

examples.en: Each contestant has three minutes to speak.
examples.zh: 每位參賽者有三分鐘的發言時間。

examples.en: The young contestant won the singing contest.
examples.zh: 那位年輕的參賽者贏得了歌唱比賽。

examples.en: Ten contestants entered the cooking show, hoping to win a cash prize.
examples.zh: 十位參賽者參加了這個烹飪節目，希望贏得獎金。

examples.en: The teacher worked to keep continuity between lessons.
examples.zh: 老師努力讓各堂課之間保持連貫。

examples.en: A good story needs continuity from start to finish.
examples.zh: 好故事需要從頭到尾保持連貫。

examples.en: The new manager wanted to ensure continuity in service.
examples.zh: 新經理想確保服務不中斷。

examples.en: Please don't contradict your teacher in class.
examples.zh: 請不要在課堂上反駁老師。

examples.en: His actions contradict what he said yesterday.
examples.zh: 他的行為與他昨天說的話相互矛盾。

examples.en: The two reports contradict each other about when the accident happened.
examples.zh: 這兩份報告對於事故發生的時間彼此矛盾。

examples.en: The principal will convene a meeting on Friday.
examples.zh: 校長將在週五召開會議。

examples.en: Parents convened in the hall to discuss the trip.
examples.zh: 家長們聚集在大廳討論旅行的事。

examples.en: The committee convenes every month to review the school budget.
examples.zh: 委員會每個月開會，審查學校預算。

examples.en: Colorful fish swim around the coral in the shallow tropical water.
examples.zh: 色彩繽紛的魚在熱帶淺水區的珊瑚周圍游動。

examples.en: Warm seas help coral grow, but excessive heat can damage it.
examples.zh: 溫暖的海水有助於珊瑚生長，但過高的水溫可能傷害珊瑚。

examples.en: She wore a necklace made of pink coral.
examples.zh: 她戴著一條粉紅色珊瑚做的項鍊。

examples.en: Detectives examined the corpse for clues before writing their report.
examples.zh: 偵探在撰寫報告前檢查屍體，尋找線索。

examples.en: The museum displays an ancient corpse found in the desert.
examples.zh: 博物館展示著在沙漠中發現的一具古代屍體。

examples.en: Doctors tried to identify the corpse using the available dental records.
examples.zh: 醫師試著利用現有的牙科紀錄辨識屍體身分。

examples.en: She keeps all her correspondence in a small box.
examples.zh: 她把所有的信件都收在一個小盒子裡。

examples.en: Our correspondence lasted for many years after we moved to different cities.
examples.zh: 我們搬到不同城市後，書信往來持續了多年。

examples.en: There is little correspondence between the two stories.
examples.zh: 這兩個故事幾乎沒有相符之處。

examples.en: She has a cosmetic bag full of brushes.
examples.zh: 她有一個裝滿刷具的化妝包。

examples.en: The repairs were only cosmetic and did not fix the leak.
examples.zh: 這些修繕只是表面功夫，並沒有修好漏水的問題。

examples.en: The factory sells cosmetic products to many countries.
examples.zh: 這家工廠把美容產品賣到許多國家。

examples.en: Her favorite cosmetic is a soft pink lipstick.
examples.zh: 她最愛的化妝品是柔和的粉紅色口紅。

examples.en: Every cosmetic on the shelf is on sale.
examples.zh: 架上的每一件化妝品都在特價。

examples.en: This cosmetic is made with natural oils.
examples.zh: 這件化妝品是用天然油製成的。

examples.en: She buys her cosmetics at the department store.
examples.zh: 她在百貨公司買化妝品。

examples.en: Cosmetics should be kept away from direct sunlight.
examples.zh: 化妝品應避免陽光直射。

examples.en: The store sells cosmetics from many countries.
examples.zh: 這家店販售來自許多國家的化妝品。

examples.en: The mayor met his counterpart from Japan.
examples.zh: 市長與日本的同級官員會面。

examples.en: The new model is faster than its counterpart.
examples.zh: 新型號比與它相對應的機種更快。

examples.en: She emailed her counterpart at the other branch.
examples.zh: 她寫電子郵件給另一間分公司的同職位同事。

examples.en: I have a coupon for a free drink.
examples.zh: 我有一張免費飲料的優待券。

examples.en: Use this coupon to save ten percent.
examples.zh: 使用這張折價券可省下一成。

examples.en: The coupon expires at the end of the month.
examples.zh: 這張優待券在月底到期。

examples.en: Students eat lunch in the school courtyard.
examples.zh: 學生們在學校中庭吃午餐。

examples.en: An old tree stands in the courtyard.
examples.zh: 庭院裡有一棵老樹。

examples.en: The hotel has a quiet courtyard with a fountain.
examples.zh: 這間旅館有個安靜的庭院，裡面有座噴泉。

examples.en: It was cowardly to blame others for his mistake.
examples.zh: 把自己的錯怪到別人頭上很懦弱。

examples.en: The cowardly dog hid under the bed.
examples.zh: 那隻膽小的狗躲到了床底下。

examples.en: She felt cowardly for not speaking up.
examples.zh: 她因為沒有站出來發言而覺得自己很懦弱。

examples.en: We spent a cozy evening by the fireplace.
examples.zh: 我們在壁爐旁度過了溫馨的夜晚。

examples.en: The café has a cozy atmosphere, with soft lighting and comfortable chairs.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡廳氣氛溫馨舒適，燈光柔和，椅子也很舒服。

examples.en: She wore a cozy sweater on the cold morning.
examples.zh: 寒冷的早晨，她穿了一件暖和舒適的毛衣。

examples.en: Police announced a crackdown on illegal parking.
examples.zh: 警方宣布嚴厲取締違規停車。

examples.en: The school began a crackdown on cheating.
examples.zh: 學校開始嚴格整頓作弊的情形。

examples.en: A crackdown on fake goods is planned for next week.
examples.zh: 下週預計嚴厲查緝仿冒品。

examples.en: She ate a cracker with some cheese.
examples.zh: 她配著起司吃了一片薄脆餅乾。

examples.en: The soup comes with two crackers and a small bread roll.
examples.zh: 這份湯附有兩片薄脆餅乾和一個小餐包。

examples.en: Someone set off a loud cracker near the temple.
examples.zh: 有人在廟旁點燃了一枚很響的鞭炮。

examples.en: I got a cramp in my leg while swimming.
examples.zh: 我游泳時腿抽筋了。

examples.en: A stomach cramp kept her home from school.
examples.zh: 胃痙攣讓她沒去上學。

examples.en: Stretching can help prevent a muscle cramp.
examples.zh: 伸展可以幫助預防肌肉抽筋。

examples.en: Wearing tight shoes can cramp your feet.
examples.zh: 穿太緊的鞋可能讓你的腳抽筋。

examples.en: Small rooms cramp the children's play, especially when they try to run.
examples.zh: 狹小的房間限制了孩子們的玩耍活動，尤其是他們想奔跑時。

examples.en: Sitting still too long may cramp your legs.
examples.zh: 坐太久不動可能會讓你的腿抽筋。

examples.en: We hiked up to the crater of the volcano.
examples.zh: 我們健行到火山口。

examples.en: A huge crater was left by the meteor.
examples.zh: 隕石留下了一個巨大的坑洞。

examples.en: The moon is covered with craters formed by impacts from space rocks.
examples.zh: 月球表面布滿了太空岩石撞擊所形成的隕石坑。

examples.en: The witness gave a credible account of the accident.
examples.zh: 目擊者對這起意外提出了可信的說法。

examples.en: Is there a credible source for this news?
examples.zh: 這則新聞有可靠的消息來源嗎？

examples.en: She is a credible candidate for the job.
examples.zh: 她是這份工作值得信賴的人選。

examples.en: The crocodile lay still beside the river.
examples.zh: 那隻鱷魚靜靜地躺在河邊。

examples.en: We saw a baby crocodile at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在動物園看到一隻小鱷魚。

examples.en: A crocodile has a very strong jaw.
examples.zh: 鱷魚有非常強壯的下顎。

examples.en: Wait for the green light at the crossing.
examples.zh: 在路口等綠燈亮再走。

examples.en: There is a railway crossing near our school.
examples.zh: 我們學校附近有一個平交道。

examples.en: The ferry crossing takes about an hour.
examples.zh: 這趟渡輪航程大約要一個小時。

examples.en: The cumulative effect of stress can harm your health.
examples.zh: 壓力累積的影響可能會損害健康。

examples.en: Our cumulative score is the highest in the class.
examples.zh: 我們的累計分數是全班最高的。

examples.en: The test measures cumulative learning over the year.
examples.zh: 這項測驗評量一整年累積的學習成果。

examples.en: Please do not park next to the curb.
examples.zh: 請不要把車停在路緣旁。

examples.en: The government put a curb on rising prices.
examples.zh: 政府對物價上漲採取了抑制措施。

examples.en: He tripped over the curb on the way to school.
examples.zh: 他在上學途中被路緣絆倒。

examples.en: We need to curb our spending this month.
examples.zh: 我們這個月需要控制開銷。

examples.en: The new rule will curb noise at night.
examples.zh: 新規定將抑制夜間的噪音。

examples.en: She tried to curb her anger in front of the class.
examples.zh: 她試著在全班面前克制怒氣。

examples.en: My parents set a curfew of ten o'clock.
examples.zh: 爸媽規定我的門禁是十點。

examples.en: The city announced a curfew after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後，市政府宣布實施宵禁。

examples.en: Dorm students must follow the curfew and return before eleven.
examples.zh: 住宿學生必須遵守門禁，在十一點前返回宿舍。

examples.en: We had chicken curry with rice for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐吃了咖哩雞飯。

examples.en: This curry is a little too spicy for me.
examples.zh: 這道咖哩對我來說有點太辣。

examples.en: My mother makes curry on rainy days.
examples.zh: 媽媽在下雨天會煮咖哩。

examples.en: It is customary to bring a gift when visiting a friend.
examples.zh: 拜訪朋友時，帶份禮物是慣例。

examples.en: He took his customary seat by the window.
examples.zh: 他坐上自己慣常坐的靠窗座位。

examples.en: A tip is customary at most restaurants here.
examples.zh: 這裡大多數餐廳習慣要給小費。

senses.zh: 懷疑他人動機的；冷嘲熱諷的

examples.en: He is cynical about politicians and rarely believes their campaign promises.
examples.zh: 他對政客抱持懷疑態度，很少相信他們的競選承諾。

examples.en: Her cynical remarks upset the whole team.
examples.zh: 她挖苦的言論讓全隊都不高興。

examples.en: Don't be so cynical about this new idea.
examples.zh: 別對這個新想法這麼冷嘲熱諷。

examples.en: The bright sun can dazzle drivers on the road.
examples.zh: 耀眼的陽光會讓路上的駕駛眼花。

examples.en: The magician hoped to dazzle the audience.
examples.zh: 魔術師希望讓觀眾驚嘆不已。

examples.en: Her beautiful voice dazzled everyone at the concert.
examples.zh: 她美妙的歌聲讓音樂會上的每個人都驚豔不已。

examples.en: The loud music will deafen you if you stand too close.
examples.zh: 如果站得太近，大聲的音樂會震得你耳朵發聾。

examples.en: The noise from the train deafened us for a moment.
examples.zh: 火車的噪音讓我們一時之間什麼都聽不見。

examples.en: Loud engines can deafen people over time.
examples.zh: 引擎的巨響久了可能使人失聰。

examples.en: She scored the decisive goal in the final minute.
examples.zh: 她在最後一分鐘踢進了決定性的一球。

examples.en: A good leader must be decisive when unexpected problems arise.
examples.zh: 好的領導者遇到突發問題時，必須果斷。

examples.en: The vote was a decisive victory for our class.
examples.zh: 這次投票是我們班的決定性勝利。

examples.en: Her dedication to teaching inspired many students.
examples.zh: 她對教學的奉獻啟發了許多學生。

examples.en: It takes dedication to practice every day.
examples.zh: 每天練習需要全心投入。

examples.en: The author wrote a short dedication to his parents.
examples.zh: 作者寫了一段簡短的題獻給他的父母。

examples.en: The store will deduct ten dollars from the price.
examples.zh: 商店會從價格中扣除十元。

examples.en: Teachers may deduct points from your grade for late work.
examples.zh: 老師可能會因為遲交作業而扣你的分數。

examples.en: You can deduct this cost from your taxes.
examples.zh: 你可以從稅金中扣除這筆費用。

examples.en: The judge deemed the evidence unreliable after examining the original documents.
examples.zh: 法官檢視原始文件後，認為這項證據不可靠。

examples.en: They deemed it wise to leave early.
examples.zh: 他們認為提早離開比較明智。

examples.en: The school deems honesty very important in both exams and daily life.
examples.zh: 學校認為，無論考試或日常生活，誠實都非常重要。

examples.en: The default language of this app is English.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式的預設語言是英文。

examples.en: The company was in default on its loan.
examples.zh: 這家公司的貸款違約了。

examples.en: Click reset to return to the default settings.
examples.zh: 點選重設即可回到預設設定。

examples.en: He defaulted on his car payments after losing his job.
examples.zh: 他失業後，未能按期繳付汽車分期款。

examples.en: The program will default to English when it starts for the first time.
examples.zh: 程式第一次啟動時，會預設為英文。

examples.en: If you don't choose, it will default to the first option.
examples.zh: 如果你不選擇，它會預設選第一個選項。

examples.en: The factory found a defect in the new toys.
examples.zh: 工廠在新玩具上發現了瑕疵。

examples.en: A small defect in the design caused the delay.
examples.zh: 設計上的一個小缺陷造成了延誤。

examples.en: Please return the product if it has any defect.
examples.zh: 如果產品有任何瑕疵，請退回。

examples.en: The player decided to defect to a rival team.
examples.zh: 那名球員決定轉投對手球隊。

examples.en: Several members threatened to defect from the club.
examples.zh: 幾名成員威脅要退出這個社團。

examples.en: Few people dared to defect to the other side.
examples.zh: 很少人敢投奔另一方。

examples.en: The boy stood in defiance of his teacher's order.
examples.zh: 那個男孩違抗了老師的命令。

examples.en: She shook her head in defiance and refused to apologize.
examples.zh: 她搖頭表示反抗，拒絕道歉。

examples.en: Wearing red was an act of defiance against the dress code.
examples.zh: 穿紅色衣服是對服裝規定的一種反抗。

examples.en: We still have no definitive answer from the manager.
examples.zh: 我們還沒有收到經理的最終答覆。

examples.en: This book is the definitive guide to birdwatching.
examples.zh: 這本書是賞鳥的權威指南。

examples.en: The test gave a definitive result after two days.
examples.zh: 這項檢驗在兩天後得出了明確的結果。

examples.en: I have a dental appointment on Friday morning.
examples.zh: 我星期五早上有牙科的預約。

examples.en: Regular dental care keeps your teeth healthy.
examples.zh: 定期的牙齒保健能讓你的牙齒保持健康。

examples.en: The school offers a free dental check for students.
examples.zh: 學校為學生提供免費的牙齒檢查。

examples.en: Running the heater all night will deplete our fuel.
examples.zh: 暖氣開一整晚會耗盡我們的燃料。

examples.en: Heavy exercise can deplete your energy quickly.
examples.zh: 激烈運動會很快耗盡你的體力。

examples.en: We should not deplete the water supply during the summer.
examples.zh: 夏天時我們不該把水資源用光。

examples.en: Lack of sleep can deprive students of their focus.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足會讓學生失去專注力。

examples.en: The new rule will deprive us of our lunch break.
examples.zh: 這項新規定會剝奪我們的午休時間。

examples.en: No child should be deprived of a good education.
examples.zh: 任何孩子都不該被剝奪接受良好教育的機會。

examples.en: The plane began its descent into the city.
examples.zh: 飛機開始朝著這座城市下降。

examples.en: The descent from the mountain took two hours.
examples.zh: 下山花了兩個小時。

examples.en: She is a woman of Italian descent.
examples.zh: 她是義大利裔的女子。

examples.en: He despises people who tell lies to take advantage of others.
examples.zh: 他鄙視那些說謊來占別人便宜的人。

examples.en: I despise waiting in long lines at the store.
examples.zh: 我很討厭在商店排長長的隊伍。

examples.en: Many students despise cheating on exams because it is unfair.
examples.zh: 許多學生鄙視考試作弊，因為這樣不公平。

examples.en: She felt she was destined to become a teacher.
examples.zh: 她覺得自己注定要成為老師。

examples.en: The package is destined for our office in Taipei.
examples.zh: 這個包裹的目的地是我們在台北的辦公室。

examples.en: They were destined to meet again one day.
examples.zh: 他們注定有一天會再相遇。

examples.en: Please detach the form along the dotted line.
examples.zh: 請沿著虛線撕下這張表格。

examples.en: You can detach the hood from the jacket.
examples.zh: 你可以把帽子從外套上拆下來。

examples.en: He tried to detach himself from the noisy crowd.
examples.zh: 他試著讓自己遠離吵鬧的人群。

examples.en: The officer had to detain the man for questioning.
examples.zh: 警察必須拘留那名男子問話。

examples.en: Customs may detain packages that lack the right forms.
examples.zh: 海關可能會扣留缺少正確文件的包裹。

examples.en: I won't detain you any longer, since you are busy.
examples.zh: 你很忙，我就不再耽誤你了。

examples.en: The suspect was held in detention for two days.
examples.zh: 嫌犯被拘留了兩天。

examples.en: Tom got detention for being late three times.
examples.zh: 湯姆因為遲到三次而被罰留校。

examples.en: The detention center has strict rules for visitors.
examples.zh: 拘留所對訪客有嚴格的規定。

examples.en: The high price did not deter people from buying tickets.
examples.zh: 高昂的價格並沒有讓人們打消購票的念頭。

examples.en: A bright light can deter thieves from entering.
examples.zh: 明亮的燈光可以嚇阻小偷進入。

examples.en: Bad weather will not deter us from going camping.
examples.zh: 壞天氣不會阻止我們去露營。

senses.zh: 狼吞虎嚥地吃；如飢似渴地閱讀

examples.en: The hungry boys devoured the pizza in minutes.
examples.zh: 飢餓的男孩們幾分鐘就把披薩吃光了。

examples.en: She devours every mystery novel in the library.
examples.zh: 她把圖書館裡的每一本推理小說都讀得津津有味。

examples.en: The lion devoured its prey quickly before returning to the shade.
examples.zh: 獅子很快就吞食了獵物，然後回到陰涼處。

examples.en: My grandfather has diabetes and checks his blood sugar often.
examples.zh: 我爺爺有糖尿病，經常檢查血糖。

examples.en: Eating too much sugar may lead to diabetes.
examples.zh: 吃太多糖可能會導致糖尿病。

examples.en: The doctor explained how to live with diabetes.
examples.zh: 醫生說明了如何與糖尿病共處。

examples.en: The dictator ruled the country for thirty years.
examples.zh: 那位獨裁者統治這個國家長達三十年。

examples.en: The book tells the story of a cruel dictator.
examples.zh: 這本書講述一位殘酷獨裁者的故事。

examples.en: People in the country dreamed of a life without a dictator.
examples.zh: 那個國家的人民夢想著沒有獨裁者的生活。

examples.en: The country lived under a harsh dictatorship for years.
examples.zh: 這個國家在嚴酷的獨裁統治下生活了多年。

examples.en: In a dictatorship, people have little say in decisions.
examples.zh: 在獨裁政權下，人民對決策幾乎沒有發言權。

examples.en: Our history class studied the fall of the dictatorship.
examples.zh: 我們的歷史課研讀了獨裁政權的垮台。

examples.en: The bus runs on diesel instead of gasoline.
examples.zh: 這輛公車使用柴油，而不是汽油。

examples.en: Diesel costs more than gas at this station.
examples.zh: 這個加油站的柴油比汽油貴。

examples.en: My uncle drives a diesel because it saves fuel.
examples.zh: 我叔叔開柴油車，因為比較省油。

examples.en: Can you differentiate between these two colors?
examples.zh: 你分得出這兩種顏色嗎？

examples.en: Young children cannot always differentiate fact from fantasy.
examples.zh: 年幼的孩子不見得能分辨事實與幻想。

examples.en: A unique logo helps differentiate our shop from others.
examples.zh: 獨特的商標讓我們的店與其他店有所區別。

examples.en: The two nations solved the problem through diplomacy.
examples.zh: 兩國透過外交途徑解決了問題。

examples.en: She handled the angry customer with great diplomacy.
examples.zh: 她以高明的手腕處理了憤怒的顧客。

examples.en: Our teacher studied diplomacy at university and later worked in an embassy.
examples.zh: 我們的老師在大學修讀外交學，後來曾在大使館工作。

examples.en: The manager issued a directive about office safety.
examples.zh: 經理發布了一項有關辦公室安全的指令。

examples.en: Teachers must follow the new directive from the school board.
examples.zh: 老師們必須遵守教育委員會的新指示。

examples.en: A directive from head office changed our schedule.
examples.zh: 總公司的一項指令改變了我們的時程。

examples.en: Please disable the alarm before you open the door.
examples.zh: 開門前請先關閉警報器。

examples.en: The virus can disable your computer by damaging essential system files.
examples.zh: 這種病毒可能破壞重要的系統檔案，讓你的電腦無法運作。

examples.en: You can disable notifications in the settings menu.
examples.zh: 你可以在設定選單中停用通知。

examples.en: The heavy rain had a disastrous effect on the farm.
examples.zh: 大雨對農場造成了災難性的影響。

examples.en: Our first attempt at cooking dinner was disastrous.
examples.zh: 我們第一次試著煮晚餐，結果糟透了。

examples.en: The company made a disastrous decision last year.
examples.zh: 那家公司去年做了一個災難性的決定。

examples.en: He stared at the test score in disbelief.
examples.zh: 他難以置信地盯著考試成績。

examples.en: The crowd shook their heads in disbelief.
examples.zh: 群眾難以置信地搖著頭。

examples.en: She read the email with growing disbelief.
examples.zh: 她讀著那封電子郵件，愈讀愈覺得難以置信。

examples.en: The hospital will discharge him on Monday.
examples.zh: 醫院將在星期一讓他出院。

examples.en: The factory must not discharge waste into the river.
examples.zh: 工廠不得把廢棄物排放到河裡。

examples.en: The company discharged two workers for breaking the rules.
examples.zh: 公司因為兩名員工違反規定而將他們解僱。

examples.en: His family celebrated his discharge from the hospital with a special dinner.
examples.zh: 家人用一頓特別的晚餐慶祝他出院。

examples.en: The discharge from the pipe smelled terrible.
examples.zh: 那根管子排出的東西聞起來很糟。

examples.en: After his discharge, he looked for a new job.
examples.zh: 被解僱後，他開始找新工作。

examples.en: He was a loyal disciple of the famous painter.
examples.zh: 他是那位知名畫家忠實的門徒。

examples.en: The teacher and his disciples walked along the river.
examples.zh: 老師和他的門徒們沿著河邊散步。

examples.en: She became a disciple of yoga after one class.
examples.zh: 她上了一堂課後就成了瑜伽的忠實信徒。

examples.en: The school took disciplinary action against the students.
examples.zh: 學校對那些學生採取了懲戒措施。

examples.en: He faced a disciplinary hearing at work.
examples.zh: 他在工作上要面對一場紀律聽證會。

examples.en: The team's disciplinary rules are very clear.
examples.zh: 這支球隊的紀律規定非常明確。

examples.en: The disclosure of the secret surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 秘密被公開讓所有人都很驚訝。

examples.en: The bank requires full disclosure of your income.
examples.zh: 銀行要求完整揭露你的收入。

examples.en: Her disclosure about the mistake helped the team.
examples.zh: 她對這個錯誤的坦白幫助了團隊。

examples.en: She felt some discomfort in her left knee.
examples.zh: 她左膝感到有點不舒服。

examples.en: The long flight caused great discomfort because the seats were narrow.
examples.zh: 這趟長途飛行因座位狹窄而讓人感到十分不適。

examples.en: He hid his discomfort with a smile.
examples.zh: 他用微笑掩飾自己的不安。

examples.en: The loud music began to discomfort the guests.
examples.zh: 吵鬧的音樂開始讓客人感到不自在。

examples.en: Questions about his past discomforted him during the job interview.
examples.zh: 求職面試時，關於他過去的問題讓他感到不安。

examples.en: Cold weather can discomfort young children who lack warm clothing.
examples.zh: 寒冷天氣會讓缺少保暖衣物的幼兒感到不舒服。

examples.en: Please be discreet when you talk about this matter.
examples.zh: 談到這件事時請謹慎一點。

examples.en: The waiter was very discreet and quiet.
examples.zh: 那位服務生非常謹慎低調。

examples.en: She made a discreet exit from the meeting.
examples.zh: 她悄悄地離開了會議。

examples.en: Cheating on the exam was a disgrace to the whole class.
examples.zh: 考試作弊是整個班級的恥辱。

examples.en: He left the team in disgrace after admitting that he cheated.
examples.zh: 他承認作弊後，蒙羞離開了球隊。

examples.en: It is no disgrace to ask for help.
examples.zh: 尋求幫助並不丟臉。

examples.en: He did not want to disgrace his family.
examples.zh: 他不想讓家人蒙羞。

examples.en: The scandal disgraced the mayor and damaged his chances of reelection.
examples.zh: 這起醜聞使市長蒙羞，也損害了他再次當選的機會。

examples.en: Do not disgrace your school by behaving badly.
examples.zh: 不要因為行為不當而讓學校蒙羞。

examples.en: She looked at the bill in dismay.
examples.zh: 她驚愕地看著帳單。

examples.en: To my dismay, the store was already closed.
examples.zh: 令我沮喪的是，商店已經關門了。

examples.en: The fans cried out in dismay when the team lost.
examples.zh: 球隊輸球時，球迷失望地大喊。

examples.en: The bad news dismayed the whole family.
examples.zh: 這個壞消息讓全家人都很沮喪。

examples.en: Her low grade dismayed her parents, who had expected better results.
examples.zh: 她的低分讓原本期待更好成績的父母感到失望。

examples.en: The long delay dismayed many travelers who had important meetings scheduled.
examples.zh: 漫長的延誤讓許多安排了重要會議的旅客感到沮喪。

examples.en: Some of these items are dispensable if the bag is too heavy.
examples.zh: 如果袋子太重，這些東西有些可以不帶。

examples.en: No team member is truly dispensable because everyone contributes something valuable.
examples.zh: 沒有哪位團隊成員是真正可有可無的，因為每個人都作出有價值的貢獻。

examples.en: The extra fee seemed dispensable to most customers.
examples.zh: 大多數顧客覺得那筆額外費用不是必要的。

examples.en: The machine can dispense hot coffee and tea.
examples.zh: 這台機器可以供應熱咖啡和熱茶。

examples.en: The pharmacist will dispense your medicine soon.
examples.zh: 藥師很快就會幫你配藥。

examples.en: The judge must dispense justice fairly, regardless of a person's social status.
examples.zh: 法官必須公平地施行正義，不論當事人的社會地位如何。

senses.zh: 用完即丟的；可自由支配的

examples.en: We used disposable cups at the picnic.
examples.zh: 我們在野餐時用了拋棄式杯子。

examples.en: He bought a disposable camera for the trip.
examples.zh: 他為這趟旅行買了一台即可拍。

examples.en: Her disposable income went up after she got a new job.
examples.zh: 她換了新工作後，可支配所得增加了。

examples.en: Proper disposal of batteries helps protect the environment.
examples.zh: 妥善處理電池有助於保護環境。

examples.en: The car is at your disposal this weekend.
examples.zh: 這個週末這輛車任你使用。

examples.en: The waste disposal truck comes every Tuesday.
examples.zh: 垃圾處理車每個星期二會來。

examples.en: Please dispose of the trash in the correct bin.
examples.zh: 請把垃圾丟進正確的垃圾桶。

examples.en: We need to dispose of these old computers safely.
examples.zh: 我們必須安全地處理這些舊電腦。

examples.en: Warm weather disposes people to spend time outdoors.
examples.zh: 溫暖的天氣讓人傾向於待在戶外。

examples.en: There was little dissent among the club members.
examples.zh: 社團成員之間幾乎沒有異議。

examples.en: The plan passed despite some dissent from members of the committee.
examples.zh: 儘管委員會部分成員持有異議，這項計畫仍通過了。

examples.en: The judge wrote a note of dissent.
examples.zh: 那位法官寫了一份不同意見書。

examples.en: Only two members dissented from the decision.
examples.zh: 只有兩名成員對這項決定持異議。

examples.en: He chose to dissent quietly rather than argue.
examples.zh: 他選擇默默表達不同意見，而不是爭論。

examples.en: Few people dared to dissent in the meeting.
examples.zh: 很少人敢在會議中表示反對。

senses.zh: 分心；讓人分心的事物；消遣

examples.en: My phone is a constant distraction when I study.
examples.zh: 我讀書時，手機總是讓我分心。

examples.en: Distraction during the meeting caused him to miss several important details.
examples.zh: 開會時分心，使他漏聽了幾項重要細節。

examples.en: Playing music is a pleasant distraction after work.
examples.zh: 工作後演奏音樂是一種愉快的消遣。

examples.en: The child cried out in distress when he could not find his mother.
examples.zh: 孩子找不到媽媽時，焦急地大聲哭喊。

examples.en: The ship sent a signal of distress.
examples.zh: 那艘船發出了求救信號。

examples.en: Her face showed deep distress after the news.
examples.zh: 聽到消息後，她的臉上露出深深的憂慮。

examples.en: The sad news distressed the whole class.
examples.zh: 這個悲傷的消息讓全班同學都很難過。

examples.en: It distresses me to see animals in pain.
examples.zh: 看到動物受苦讓我很難過。

examples.en: Do not distress your mother with bad news.
examples.zh: 不要用壞消息讓你媽媽擔心。

examples.en: The shop plans to diversify its range of products.
examples.zh: 這家店打算讓商品種類更多元。

examples.en: Smart investors diversify their savings across several types of investments.
examples.zh: 聰明的投資人會把儲蓄分散到多種類型的投資中。

examples.en: The school wants to diversify its after-class activities.
examples.zh: 學校希望讓課後活動更多元。

senses.zh: 改道；消遣；轉移注意的手段

examples.en: Road work caused a diversion on the main street.
examples.zh: 道路施工使主要街道必須改道。

examples.en: Reading is a good diversion on a rainy day.
examples.zh: 下雨天閱讀是不錯的消遣。

examples.en: The magician used a diversion to hide the coin.
examples.zh: 魔術師用轉移注意力的手法把硬幣藏起來。

examples.en: Police had to divert traffic around the accident.
examples.zh: 警方必須將車流改道繞過事故地點。

examples.en: She tried to divert his attention from the problem.
examples.zh: 她試著把他的注意力從問題上轉移開。

examples.en: The city decided to divert funds to the new library.
examples.zh: 市政府決定把經費轉用於新圖書館。

examples.en: The company pays a dividend every quarter.
examples.zh: 這家公司每一季都發放股利。

examples.en: My father received a small dividend from his shares.
examples.zh: 我爸爸從他的股票收到了一小筆股息。

examples.en: In the problem, twelve is the dividend and three is the divisor.
examples.zh: 在這個題目裡，十二是被除數，三是除數。

examples.en: The dark clouds seemed to promise doom for the picnic.
examples.zh: 烏雲似乎預告了這場野餐的厄運。

examples.en: He felt a sense of doom before the exam.
examples.zh: 考試前他有一種大難臨頭的感覺。

examples.en: The old story speaks of the doom of a great city.
examples.zh: 這個古老的故事講述一座大城的毀滅。

examples.en: Poor planning doomed the project from the start.
examples.zh: 糟糕的規劃讓這項專案從一開始就注定失敗。

examples.en: The weak team seemed doomed to lose.
examples.zh: 那支實力較弱的球隊似乎注定要輸。

examples.en: Lack of money doomed the new business.
examples.zh: 缺乏資金使這家新事業注定失敗。

examples.en: The city took drastic steps to cut down on traffic.
examples.zh: 市政府採取了強硬的措施來減少交通量。

examples.en: There was a drastic change in the weather overnight.
examples.zh: 天氣一夜之間出現劇烈的變化。

examples.en: There was a drastic drop in prices after the sale began.
examples.zh: 特賣開始後，價格出現了大幅下跌。

examples.en: Would you like some dressing on your salad?
examples.zh: 你的沙拉要加醬料嗎？

examples.en: The nurse changed the dressing on his arm.
examples.zh: 護理師換了他手臂上的敷料。

examples.en: I made the dressing with oil, vinegar, and salt.
examples.zh: 我用油、醋和鹽調製了這份醬汁。

examples.en: The room has dual purposes, as a study and a guest room.
examples.zh: 這個房間有雙重用途，既是書房也是客房。

examples.en: He holds dual citizenship in Taiwan and Canada.
examples.zh: 他同時擁有台灣和加拿大的雙重國籍。

examples.en: The car has a dual control system for driving lessons.
examples.zh: 這輛車有供駕訓課使用的雙重操控系統。

examples.en: I am dubious about the claims in this advertisement.
examples.zh: 我對這則廣告裡的說法存疑。

examples.en: The shop sells goods of dubious quality.
examples.zh: 這家店賣的商品品質可疑。

examples.en: She gave me a dubious look when I told the story.
examples.zh: 我講那個故事時，她投來懷疑的眼神。

examples.en: The story has seven dwarfs who live in a small house.
examples.zh: 這個故事裡有住在小房子裡的七個小矮人。

examples.en: The apple tree is a dwarf that stays small even when fully grown.
examples.zh: 這棵蘋果樹是矮生品種，即使完全長成也很小。

examples.en: Through the telescope, the astronomer observed a faint white dwarf.
examples.zh: 天文學家透過望遠鏡觀測到一顆暗淡的白矮星。

senses.zh: 使顯得矮小；使相形見絀

examples.en: The tall building dwarfs the houses around it.
examples.zh: 那棟高樓讓周圍的房子顯得矮小。

examples.en: Her talent dwarfs that of the other students.
examples.zh: 她的才華使其他學生相形見絀。

examples.en: The surrounding mountains dwarf the small village at the bottom of the valley.
examples.zh: 四周群山讓谷底的小村莊顯得渺小。

examples.en: Many families dwell in small apartments near the harbor.
examples.zh: 許多家庭住在港口附近的小公寓裡。

examples.en: Some old people still dwell in the village where they were born.
examples.zh: 有些老人仍然住在他們出生的村子裡。

examples.en: Try not to dwell on your mistakes after the exam.
examples.zh: 考試結束後，別老是想著自己的錯誤。

examples.en: The family moved into a new dwelling by the river.
examples.zh: 這家人搬進了河邊的新住所。

examples.en: Each dwelling in the village has a small garden.
examples.zh: 村裡的每間住宅都有一座小花園。

examples.en: The old dwelling was repaired before the winter began.
examples.zh: 那棟舊住宅在冬天開始前就修繕好了。

examples.en: Our eccentric neighbor wears a hat even indoors.
examples.zh: 我們那位古怪的鄰居連在室內也戴著帽子。

examples.en: The artist is known for his eccentric habits.
examples.zh: 那位藝術家以其怪異的習慣聞名。

examples.en: My uncle has an eccentric way of explaining math.
examples.zh: 我叔叔講解數學的方式與眾不同。

examples.en: Students watched the solar eclipse through special glasses.
examples.zh: 學生們透過特製眼鏡觀看日蝕。

examples.en: The lunar eclipse will begin around ten o'clock tonight.
examples.zh: 月蝕將在今晚十點左右開始。

examples.en: People gathered on the roof to see the eclipse.
examples.zh: 人們聚集在屋頂上觀看這場日蝕。

examples.en: Her talent began to eclipse that of the other players.
examples.zh: 她的才華開始讓其他選手黯然失色。

examples.en: The new mall may eclipse the old shopping street.
examples.zh: 這間新的購物中心可能會使老商店街相形失色。

examples.en: His success eclipsed all of his brother's achievements.
examples.zh: 他的成功使他哥哥的所有成就都黯然失色。

examples.en: Regular exercise can elevate your mood during exams.
examples.zh: 考試期間，規律運動能讓你的心情變好。

examples.en: The company plans to elevate her to department manager.
examples.zh: 公司打算把她升為部門經理。

examples.en: Please elevate your leg to reduce the swelling.
examples.zh: 請把腿抬高，以減輕腫脹。

examples.en: Many emigrants send money back to their families every month.
examples.zh: 許多移民每個月都會寄錢回家給家人。

examples.en: The emigrant missed the food from his hometown.
examples.zh: 那位移民很想念家鄉的食物。

examples.en: My grandfather was an emigrant who left Italy at twenty.
examples.zh: 我祖父是個二十歲就離開義大利的移民。

examples.en: Her parents decided to emigrate to Canada last year.
examples.zh: 她的父母去年決定移民加拿大。

examples.en: Many young workers emigrate in search of better jobs.
examples.zh: 許多年輕的工作者為了尋找更好的工作而移居國外。

examples.en: He plans to emigrate once he finishes his studies.
examples.zh: 他打算一完成學業就移居國外。

examples.en: Emigration from the small island has increased in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年來，從這座小島移居國外的人數增加了。

examples.en: The government wants to slow down the emigration of doctors.
examples.zh: 政府想減緩醫師外移的情形。

examples.en: Her essay is about emigration and family life.
examples.zh: 她的文章談的是移居國外與家庭生活。

examples.en: I looked up the word in an encyclopedia at the library.
examples.zh: 我在圖書館的百科全書裡查了這個字。

examples.en: This online encyclopedia is free for everyone to use.
examples.zh: 這個線上百科全書任何人都能免費使用。

examples.en: Our teacher asked us to read the encyclopedia entry on volcanoes.
examples.zh: 老師要我們閱讀百科全書中關於火山的條目。

examples.en: Learning a new language is a difficult endeavor.
examples.zh: 學習一種新語言是一件困難的事。

examples.en: The team made every endeavor to finish the project on time.
examples.zh: 團隊盡了一切努力，要準時完成這項專案。

examples.en: Her endeavor to raise money for the school was a success.
examples.zh: 她為學校募款的努力成功了。

examples.en: We endeavor to answer every email within one day.
examples.zh: 我們盡力在一天內回覆每一封電子郵件。

examples.en: The teacher endeavored to make the lesson fun.
examples.zh: 老師努力讓這堂課變得有趣。

examples.en: Students should endeavor to arrive on time.
examples.zh: 學生應該盡力準時抵達。

examples.en: The university received a large endowment from a former student.
examples.zh: 這所大學收到一位校友捐贈的大筆基金。

examples.en: The endowment pays for scholarships every year.
examples.zh: 這筆基金每年用來支付獎學金。

examples.en: She has a natural endowment for music.
examples.zh: 她對音樂有與生俱來的天賦。

examples.en: The documentary helped enlighten viewers about climate change.
examples.zh: 這部紀錄片幫助觀眾了解氣候變遷。

examples.en: Could you enlighten me on how this machine works?
examples.zh: 你能告訴我這台機器是怎麼運作的嗎？

examples.en: Good teachers enlighten their students and inspire them to learn.
examples.zh: 好老師會啟發學生，並激勵他們學習。

examples.en: Traveling abroad can enrich your understanding of other cultures.
examples.zh: 出國旅行能豐富你對其他文化的認識。

examples.en: Farmers use compost to enrich the soil.
examples.zh: 農夫用堆肥讓土壤更肥沃。

examples.en: Reading every night helped enrich her vocabulary.
examples.zh: 每晚閱讀幫助她充實了字彙量。

examples.en: Some people equate money with happiness when choosing their future careers.
examples.zh: 有些人在選擇未來職業時，會把金錢等同於快樂。

examples.en: You should not equate a high price with good quality.
examples.zh: 你不該把高價等同於高品質。

examples.en: It is wrong to equate silence with agreement.
examples.zh: 把沉默視為同意是不對的。

examples.en: A guard will escort you to the meeting room.
examples.zh: 警衛會陪你到會議室。

examples.en: Two officers escorted the visitors through the crowd.
examples.zh: 兩名警員護送訪客穿過人群。

examples.en: He offered to escort her home after the concert.
examples.zh: 他提議在音樂會後陪她回家。

examples.en: The president arrived with a police escort.
examples.zh: 總統在警察護衛下抵達。

examples.en: The bus had an escort of two motorcycles.
examples.zh: 那輛公車有兩輛機車護送。

examples.en: She asked her brother to be her escort at the dance.
examples.zh: 她請哥哥在舞會上當她的陪伴者。

examples.en: The students hold their principal in high esteem.
examples.zh: 學生們非常敬重他們的校長。

examples.en: Her honesty won her the esteem of her classmates.
examples.zh: 她的誠實贏得了同學的敬重。

examples.en: He earned the esteem of his coworkers through hard work.
examples.zh: 他靠著努力工作贏得了同事的敬重。

examples.en: Everyone in town esteems the old doctor.
examples.zh: 鎮上每個人都敬重那位老醫師。

examples.en: She is highly esteemed by her teammates.
examples.zh: 她深受隊友敬重。

examples.en: We esteem honesty above all other qualities.
examples.zh: 我們把誠實看得比其他品格都重要。

examples.en: The poem is about love that lasts for eternity.
examples.zh: 這首詩寫的是永恆的愛。

examples.en: The wait at the bus stop felt like an eternity.
examples.zh: 在公車站牌前等車感覺像是等了一輩子。

examples.en: Many religions teach that the soul lives for eternity.
examples.zh: 許多宗教教導人的靈魂會永遠存在。

examples.en: Teachers asked everyone to evacuate the building during the fire drill.
examples.zh: 在消防演習時，老師請大家撤離這棟大樓。

examples.en: Residents were told to evacuate before the typhoon arrived.
examples.zh: 居民被告知要在颱風來臨前撤離。

examples.en: The hotel had to evacuate all of its guests.
examples.zh: 旅館必須疏散所有的房客。

examples.en: Pine trees are evergreen, so they stay green all winter.
examples.zh: 松樹是常綠的，所以整個冬天都保持綠色。

examples.en: This evergreen plant needs very little water.
examples.zh: 這種常綠植物只需要很少的水。

examples.en: The singer's evergreen songs are still loved by many fans.
examples.zh: 那位歌手的長青歌曲仍深受許多歌迷喜愛。

examples.en: We decorated an evergreen for the holiday party.
examples.zh: 我們為節慶派對裝飾了一棵常綠樹。

examples.en: An evergreen can survive in very cold weather.
examples.zh: 常綠樹能在非常寒冷的天氣中存活。

examples.en: The garden has several tall evergreens along the fence.
examples.zh: 花園裡沿著圍籬種了幾棵高大的常綠樹。

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread can evoke happy childhood memories.
examples.zh: 剛出爐麵包的香味能喚起快樂的童年回憶。

examples.en: The old photo evoked strong feelings in my grandmother.
examples.zh: 那張舊照片在我祖母心中引起強烈的情感。

examples.en: The film's music helps evoke a sense of mystery.
examples.zh: 這部電影的音樂有助於營造神祕感。

examples.en: Each examinee must show an ID card at the door.
examples.zh: 每位考生都必須在門口出示身分證件。

examples.en: The examinee finished the test ten minutes early.
examples.zh: 那位考生提早十分鐘寫完了考卷。

examples.en: Examinees are not allowed to use their phones in the room.
examples.zh: 考生不可以在考場內使用手機。

examples.en: She excels at math and science and often helps her classmates.
examples.zh: 她的數學和科學表現突出，也常幫助同學。

examples.en: Our team hopes to excel in the national contest.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍希望在全國比賽中表現出色。

examples.en: He excelled in every subject during his first year.
examples.zh: 他第一年每一科都表現得很出色。

examples.en: The teacher read an excerpt from the novel to the class.
examples.zh: 老師對全班朗讀了這本小說的節錄。

examples.en: You can read a short excerpt on the publisher's website.
examples.zh: 你可以在出版社的網站上讀到一小段節錄。

examples.en: This excerpt comes from a speech given in 1963.
examples.zh: 這段節錄出自一九六三年的一場演說。

examples.en: An excess of sugar can harm your health.
examples.zh: 攝取過量的糖會損害健康。

examples.en: The airline charged us for the excess over the baggage allowance.
examples.zh: 航空公司向我們收取行李超出限額部分的費用。

examples.en: After filling the orders, the shop sold the excess at half price.
examples.zh: 完成訂單後，商店以半價出售剩餘商品。

examples.en: Pour the excess water out of the bowl.
examples.zh: 把碗裡多餘的水倒掉。

examples.en: You will be charged for excess baggage at the airport.
examples.zh: 在機場，超重的行李要另外收費。

examples.en: The cook cut off the excess fat from the meat.
examples.zh: 廚師把肉上多餘的肥肉切掉。

examples.en: The exclusion of children from the event upset many parents.
examples.zh: 小孩被排除在活動之外，讓許多家長感到不滿。

examples.en: Experiencing exclusion at school can hurt a student's confidence.
examples.zh: 在學校遭到排擠，可能會傷害學生的自信。

examples.en: The policy covers most repairs, with a few exclusions.
examples.zh: 這項保單涵蓋大多數的維修，只有少數除外情形。

examples.en: Students with a doctor's note are exempt from gym class.
examples.zh: 有醫師證明的學生可免上體育課。

examples.en: Books for children are exempt from the tax.
examples.zh: 兒童書籍可以免稅。

examples.en: Senior citizens are exempt from paying the entry fee.
examples.zh: 年長者免付入場費。

examples.en: The school will exempt her from the final exam.
examples.zh: 學校會讓她不必參加期末考。

examples.en: The new law exempts small shops from the fee.
examples.zh: 新法律讓小商店免繳這項費用。

examples.en: A bad knee exempted him from the long run.
examples.zh: 膝蓋不好讓他不必參加長跑。

examples.en: You must exert more effort if you want to pass the test.
examples.zh: 如果你想通過考試，就必須更加努力。

examples.en: Parents can exert a strong influence on their children.
examples.zh: 父母能對孩子施加很大的影響。

examples.en: He exerted all his strength to push open the heavy door.
examples.zh: 他使出全力，試圖推開那扇沉重的門。

examples.en: The family keeps a record of its monthly expenditure.
examples.zh: 這個家庭記錄每個月的支出。

examples.en: The city plans to cut its expenditure on road repairs.
examples.zh: 市政府打算削減道路維修的經費。

examples.en: Food is the largest expenditure for most students living abroad.
examples.zh: 對大多數在國外生活的學生來說，餐費是最大的開銷。

examples.en: Please check the expiration date on the milk.
examples.zh: 請檢查牛奶上的到期日。

examples.en: The expiration of the contract is next month.
examples.zh: 合約下個月就到期了。

examples.en: My passport is close to expiration, so I need a new one.
examples.zh: 我的護照快到期了，所以需要辦新的。

examples.en: My library card will expire at the end of the month.
examples.zh: 我的借書證將在月底到期。

examples.en: This coupon expires on Friday, so use it soon.
examples.zh: 這張優惠券週五到期，請儘快使用。

examples.en: Your visa will expire before the trip ends.
examples.zh: 你的簽證會在旅程結束前到期。

examples.en: The dentist had to extract a bad tooth.
examples.zh: 牙醫必須拔掉一顆壞牙。

examples.en: This machine can extract juice from oranges very quickly.
examples.zh: 這台機器能很快地從柳橙中榨出果汁。

examples.en: Students were asked to extract the main ideas from the article.
examples.zh: 學生被要求從文章中摘出主要觀點。

examples.en: This cake is flavored with vanilla extract.
examples.zh: 這個蛋糕是用香草精調味的。

examples.en: The soap contains an extract from green tea.
examples.zh: 這款肥皂含有綠茶萃取物。
